proposal.reason: Main changes are to contributor/review automation behavior: .github/scripts/review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py alter module classification schema, invitation/withdrawal logic, and approval-gate messaging, while .github/workflows/commit-message.yml and commit_message_squash.py change when and how squash previews are published. These are review/routing policy and workflow wiring changes, not PCCL runtime module implementations.
